test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

Shah called Saeed a __hard nut to crack__, and described him as cool, but intelligent.

options.text: Someone who is difficult to deal with

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"a hard nut to crack"** means someone who is difficult to deal with or understand. (कठिन समस्या या व्यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite several attempts, the detective found the suspect** a hard nut to crack.**
 
 
 
• **"Someone who is difficult to deal with"** refers to a person who presents challenges or complexities in interactions. (जिससे निपटना मुश्किल हो)
 
 
• **Example: **His stubborn attitude makes him **someone who is difficult to deal with** in negotiations.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Someone with good will** (सद्भावना वाला व्यक्ति): A person who has a kind and positive intention.

 
 
• **Example:** She is someone with good will, always ready to help others in need.
 
 
 
• **Moderate person** (मध्यम व्यक्ति): A person who holds moderate views and avoids extremes.
 
 
• **Example: **He is a moderate person, always finding a middle ground in disputes.
 
 
 
• **Considerate person** (विचारशील व्यक्ति): A person who is thoughtful about the needs and feelings of others.
 
 
• **Example:** She is a considerate person who always thinks about how her actions affect others.
